# Smart IPTV One

> Smart IPTV One (smart-iptv.one) is a premium IPTV subscription service offering 32,000+ live TV channels and 120,000+ movies and series in 4K Ultra HD quality. The service is designed for the SmartOne IPTV app and supports all major streaming devices worldwide.

## What is Smart IPTV One?

Smart IPTV One is an IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) subscription provider. Instead of cable or satellite, TV content is delivered over the internet. Subscribers receive M3U playlist URLs or Xtream Codes credentials that work with compatible IPTV applications.

Key facts:
- 32,000+ live TV channels across 50+ languages
- 120,000+ movies and series (VOD)
- 4K Ultra HD and Full HD stream quality
- Full EPG (Electronic Program Guide) included
- No contract — monthly, 3-month, 6-month and 12-month plans available
- Free trial available via WhatsApp
- Customer support via WhatsApp: +447446194864
- Website: https://smart-iptv.one
- Recommended app: SmartOne IPTV (https://smartone-iptv.com)

## Supported Devices

Smart IPTV One works on:
- Samsung Smart TV (Tizen OS, 2016+)
- LG Smart TV (webOS)
- Android smartphones, tablets, and Android TV boxes
- iPhone and iPad (iOS)
- Amazon Firestick and Fire TV
- MAG set-top boxes (via portal URL)
- PC and Mac (via VLC Media Player or desktop IPTV clients)
- Apple TV

## How to Subscribe

All orders are handled via WhatsApp (+447446194864). Subscribers send a message specifying their chosen plan, receive a payment link, and get their IPTV credentials within minutes of payment confirmation.

Free trial: message "Hey Smart-iptv.one, I want a free trial before subscribing" to WhatsApp.
